title: Unpopular opinion: graphics peaked around 2015
caption: Unpopular opinion: graphics peaked around 2015. Agree or disagree? #hottake #graphics #witcher3 #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: graphics peaked around 2015.

The Witcher 3 came out in 2015 and still looks great. Newer games cost far more and look barely better. Metal Gear Solid V ran at a smooth 60fps on a 2013 console. Today we get 30fps and upscaling. Uncharted 4 still beats plenty of new releases. The leap since then is tiny. Agree?
